parse.title: Ultra Greed Coin
parse.text:
Ultra Greed Coins are enemies exclusively spawned by Ultra Greed during some of his attacks.

Spinner Coin

     

Entity Image


Base HP

Stage HP

50
0

Entity ID

293.0

Found In

Spinner Coins will spin around the room. Unlike the other coins, these deal contact damage, but won't do anything if they are not destroyed in time. They also last longer.

Key Coin

     

Entity Image


Base HP

Stage HP

60
0

Entity ID

293.1

Found In

Key Coins open the golden doors around Ultra Greed's boss room if not destroyed, which spawn hordes of Greed Gapers.

Bomb Coin

     

Entity Image


Base HP

Stage HP

50
0

Entity ID

293.2

Found In

Bomb Coins explode with a large radius if not destroyed, but a single explosion can deal 40 damage to Ultra Greed. Bomb Coins spawned by Ultra Greedier can drop Coins.

Heart Coin

     

Entity Image


Base HP

Stage HP

40
0

Entity ID

293.3

Found In

Heart Coins heal Ultra Greed for 13.125 HP each if not destroyed.

Notes

  • The Coins all gain +15% HP after unlocking Everything is Terrible 2!!! and their timings (breaking up and activating effect) are 10% faster.
